key_points: ENB has declined ~17% from its May record high, driven by rising bond yields, equity offering dilution, and limited visibility on the 5% long-term growth guidance
BMO Capital sees a rebound opportunity, suggesting the selloff may be overdone relative to fundamentals
Scotiabank updated FY2026 earnings forecasts, but details are not material enough to change thesis
Daily underperformance vs. the broader market (-1.09%) is routine noise for a large-cap pipeline stock
No thesis-changing catalyst present; the headwinds (rates, growth visibility) are structural but already largely priced in
